name: Acoustophoretic Volumetric Display
definition: A free-space volumetric display that renders 3D graphics by holding a millimetric particle in midair using acoustic radiation forces and moving it rapidly along a 3D path while synchronously illuminating it with colored light to exploit persistence of vision.
summary: An Acoustophoretic Volumetric Display renders 3D graphics in free space by trapping and rapidly moving a particle with ultrasonic forces, distinguishing itself from photophoretic displays by using acoustic rather than optical forces.
